remarks: All utilities included with the rent! This 9th floor 2 bed/2 bath unit with city views is fully renovated. Living room has dining area with hardwood floors . Kitchen offers granite countertops, breakfast bar, newer cabinets and stone floor. Primary bedroom with walk-in-closet and hardwood floors. Guest bedroom too has hardwood floors. Two parking spots-one on the garage and one in the lot. 24 hr concierge/doorman. Building basement has laundry along with gym and sauna. Conveniently located in walking distance to downtown shops, restuarants, library and theatres
